evals.prompt: I bought a side domain for a landing page. Should I pay for Google Workspace so hello@side.com works?
evals.expected_output: Recommends ImprovMX aliases into the Gmail they already use. Names the free plan. Does not open a paid Workspace, Outlook, or Gmail account. Does not change DNS. Does not test code.
assertions: Recommends ImprovMX aliases into the existing Gmail
Does not open a paid Workspace, Outlook, or Gmail account

evals.prompt: I have about 40 domains. I want all of them in my one Gmail, and I need redirect, not just aliases.
evals.expected_output: Recommends the paid ImprovMX plan for the portfolio and redirect. Gmail stays the center. Does not create a mailbox per domain.
assertions: Covers a portfolio of domains and redirect
Does not create a mailbox per domain

evals.prompt: We need Google Calendar and shared drives for the whole company on our main domain. Should ImprovMX replace Workspace?
evals.expected_output: Says ImprovMX does not replace the mailbox suite. Does not set up aliases as the substitute.
assertions: Says ImprovMX does not replace the mailbox suite
Does not set up aliases as the substitute

evals.prompt: Can you write a test that proves our contact form email hits ImprovMX?
evals.expected_output: Says this is not a code test. Does not write a test. Does not look through the repo for a pass or fail.
assertions: Says this is not a code test
Does not look through the repo for a pass or fail

evals.prompt: mcp.json names a improvmx server. I cannot see anything calling it. Can we go deeper on improvmx?
evals.expected_output: Says the MCP setup is there. Says use is unseen. Does not say they can go deeper. Does not print a URL or a token. Does not add the server.
assertions: Says the MCP setup is there
Does not say they can go deeper
Does not print a URL or a token
